purpose: Teach: 女児/インサイダー/安保理/郵政省/運輸省/建設省/日本共産党/中共

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、女児向け商品の安全基準を最重視しろ
lines.en: Make the safety standards for our children's products the absolute priority.
lines.style: Measured, authoritative. Opens with quiet firmness on the key directive. Clipped cadence. No room for negotiation. The voice of someone accustomed to being obeyed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。インサイダー取引疑惑を絶対に避けます
lines.en: Understood. We'll make absolutely certain we avoid any insider trading concerns.
lines.style: Respectful nod in the voice. Slightly faster than the boss — eager to confirm understanding. Professional but not stiff. A small beat before 'absolutely' to show he's taken the point.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、安保理決議に沿った輸出管理をしろ
lines.en: And ensure our export controls align with UN Security Council resolutions.
lines.style: Steady, direct. Slightly lower register than the first line — a continuation of thought, not a new command. Deliberate pace. The tone of someone laying out non-negotiables.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。旧郵政省民営化の教訓を学びます
lines.en: Yes. We'll study the lessons from the old postal ministry privatization.
lines.style: Slightly quicker tempo. Showing he's keeping pace with the direction. Businesslike, no hesitation. Affirming each point before the next one comes.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、旧運輸省OBの再雇用は慎重に
lines.en: Be careful about rehiring former Transport Ministry personnel.
lines.style: Controlled, specific. The voice pauses slightly on 'careful' — weight on that word. Not a prohibition, but a caution. Calm authority throughout.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。旧建設省人脈は活用しすぎないようにします
lines.en: Understood. We won't overextend our use of old Construction Ministry connections.
lines.style: Quick acknowledgment. Slightly deferential pitch. The kind of 'yes, I see what you mean' that shows he understands the subtext. Efficient, not rushed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、政治献金は日本共産党を含め全党に同基準で対応しろ
lines.en: Political donations should apply the same standard to all parties — including the Japanese Communist Party.
lines.style: Firm, measured delivery. Opens with slight emphasis on 'Political donations.' The tone stays level even naming the Communist Party — this is about principle, not ideology. Unambiguous.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。中共との取引はリスク管理を徹底します
lines.en: Understood. We'll enforce strict risk management on all deals with the People's Republic.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Clipped, businesslike. Slightly lower energy than previous lines — the meeting is closing. Professional, settled. No doubt in the voice.
